description: Findings 1-5 and 7 from the 2026-08-21 fresh-agent acceptance review of the integration branch (ACCEPT-WITH-NOTES): (1) commit/4 @spec says {:error, :abort} but every reply site sends :aborted; (2) dead service_map type + ServiceDescriptor alias in transaction_system_layout.ex; (3) unreachable :locked clause for :apply_metadata_and_route (guard-only-real-hazards); (4) resolver stale-window preclusion enforced by clause-fallthrough needs a legible statement; (5) routing-cache eviction breadth: drop :timeout/:unknown from @routing_invalidating_failures — FDB's locationCache survives timeouts (only definitive routing-shaped signals evict); slow is not stale, and dead pids already surface as :unavailable; (7) Repo.clear_range doc line pointing at end_of_user_keyspace/0 for the :end-sentinel key_out_of_range trap.

comments.text: Cold audit of PR #183: PASS-WITH-NOTES, no blocking. Behavior change verified safe: dead-node refs evict (nodedown maps to :unavailable in Calls.ex and the Materializer catch-all), so the narrowed list cannot strand a stale cache permanently. Two recorded residuals, both pre-existing and out of scope here: (a) during node auto-connect (~net_setuptime) a call can hit its 50ms timeout before nodedown manifests - bounded seconds-long no-eviction window; (b) storage_racing degrades a timeout on the cached-fastest server via :lists.delete to an empty race -> :no_servers_to_race, which IS invalidating - on today's singleton-ref shards a persistently slow server still evicts on the second read, slightly undercutting slow-is-not-stale; revisit if refetch traffic appears (same watch-item as the eviction-breadth note). choose_a_reason's hd(Map.keys) arbitrariness is moot with singleton refs.

title: Post-merge evaluation cleanup: spec honesty, dead types, precluded-hazard residues, timeout-eviction parity
